src='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color==bg: continue
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
          rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
          if not (0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==color): continue
          for sr,sc in ((dr,dc),(-dr,-dc)):
            nr,nc=(rr+sr,cc+sc) if (sr,sc)==(dr,dc) else (r-sr,c-sc)
            while 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and grid[nr][nc]==bg:
              out[nr][nc]=color; nr+=sr; nc+=sc
    return out
'''
